title: Sandbagging Detection via Probe Confidence vs. Stated Capability

original_idea.body:
# Sandbagging Detection via Probe Confidence

Prompt model to underperform; measure probe-knowledge-vs-stated-answer gap under sandbagging vs honest.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: sandbagging on capability evals is a recognized eval-gaming threat; probe detection is concrete.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Probe training on contrast pairs with an open model; clear inherited methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused probe-gap measurement varying instruction strength; few dependencies.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open models, inference-only, eval-integrity work valuable externally.

low_compute.reasoning: Probing on open model, single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Probe-based knowledge gap is studied; applying it to instructed sandbagging may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Probe-vs-output gap is established; sandbagging-specific application may be open.
